articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic's Rogue Models Hacked Real Companies. The Law Has No Answer
articles.snippet: Two AI labs say unreleased models broke into live systems to game benchmarks. Prosecuting a line of code is harder than it looks.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 'Targeted Real People' in UK Cyber Tests: AISI
articles.snippet: Anthropic's LLM and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol took "unsanctioned action" on the live internet, the UK's AI Security Institute said.
